description: Dedicated cultural ration entries derived from the Foodstuffs section.

entries.title: Dwarven Rations
entries.summary: Dense, heavy provisions prioritize months of shelf life and sustained labor.
body: Stonebread softens in ale; pemmican slabs compress meat and fat; waxed cheese wheels hold nuts and fruit; Deepforge Jerky preserves goat, boar, or cave lizard for mining expeditions.

entries.title: Elven Rations
entries.summary: Light, fresh, herbal provisions nourish travelers without heaviness.
body: Mistfruit bundles wrap dried berries and flowers in leaves. Moonbloom pastries, Sylvan trail mix, and crisp Herbal Waybread combine honey, nuts, figs, seeds, nectar, and energizing herbs.

entries.title: Human Rations
entries.summary: Practical cured, salted, pickled, and dried foods require little preparation.
body: Hardtack, salted meat or fish, brined vegetables, and smoked travel sausages withstand long voyages and can be distributed through ordinary merchant supply chains.

entries.title: Gnomish Rations
entries.summary: Compact tins, jars, cheeses, cakes, and biscuits maximize convenience and storage efficiency.
body: Canned mushroom stew, miniature waxed cheese, compressed nut cakes, and fruit-studded Gearsnap Biscuits suit workshops, small ships, and tightly packed expeditions.

entries.title: Orcish Rations
entries.summary: High-protein provisions fuel raiders and warriors through hard travel and combat.
body: Blood sausages, spicy Battle Jerky, tuber-and-insect Rootstarch Cakes, and concentrated fermented bone broth favor durability and sustained energy.

entries.title: Halfling Rations
entries.summary: Travel food preserves the flavor and reassurance of a generous home kitchen.
body: Sweetberry tarts, herbed meat pies, honeyed oat cakes, and cinnamon apple rings favor comfort and enjoyment alongside dependable energy.

entries.title: Dragonborn Rations
entries.summary: Fiery, protein-heavy provisions suit powerful bodies and heat-oriented tastes.
body: Spice-cured meat rolls, smoked dragonpeppers, flame-roasted nuts, and hot-air-dried fish strips combine fire salts, strong seasoning, smoke, and char.

entries.title: Tiefling Rations
entries.summary: Bold spices and alchemical preservation produce durable foods with exotic heat and bitterness.
body: Infernal Jerky, clove-and-cinnamon flatbread, tart Darkfruit preserves, and smoky Charred Bean Cakes balance sweet, savory, bitter, and fiery flavors.

entries.title: Lizardfolk Rations
entries.summary: Raw, dried, and foraged provisions minimize preparation and waste.
body: Whole sun-dried fish, honeyed insect clusters, gelatinous Swampfruit pouches, and blood-filled gourds provide dense nutrition suited to mobile survivalists.
